sources.title: PPTAgent: Generating and Evaluating Presentations Beyond Text-to-Slides
sources.author: Zheng et al.
sources.finding: Separates content, design and coherence; uses reference analysis and editing.
sources.decision: Measure dimensions separately and preserve draft-to-revision evidence. We do not reuse its historical benchmark data.

sources.title: DECKBench
sources.author: Jang et al.
sources.finding: Studies deck generation and subsequent natural-language edits.
sources.decision: Give every branch the same factual change request and check preservation of unrelated facts.

sources.title: PresentBench
sources.author: Chen et al.
sources.finding: Uses task-specific checklists to measure compliance and content fidelity separately from presentation design.
sources.decision: Use 12 visible checks per brief alongside five quality dimensions. Our batched checks are cheaper but less granular than its per-check calls.

sources.title: Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena
sources.author: Zheng et al.
sources.finding: Reports position and self-enhancement biases in model judges.
sources.decision: Blind producers, use three independent judges, exclude same-vendor judges in sensitivity analysis, and reverse pairwise order.

sources.title: python-pptx documentation
sources.author: python-pptx contributors
sources.finding: Creates and updates native editable text, shapes, charts and tables.
sources.decision: Compile a shared declarative interface into native PPTX. This fixes the tool surface across vendors and avoids executing generated code.

sources.title: Working with charts
sources.author: python-pptx contributors
sources.finding: Supports native category charts backed by chart data.
sources.decision: Test chart values after reopening the PPTX; keep this engineering check separate from screenshot quality ratings.

sources.title: Slide.Export method
sources.author: Microsoft
sources.finding: Exports individual slides with explicit pixel width and height.
sources.decision: Render actual PPTX files using one fixed engine and 1440 by 810 pixels for all arms.

design_choices.reason: Same tools, geometry units and renderer for every producer; editable charts and tables are directly testable.
design_choices.unmeasured_alternative: Unrestricted python-pptx, PptxGenJS or Artifact Tool code may allow better layouts. The pilot does not establish the best authoring backend.

design_choices.reason: Separates deterministic reusable layout assistance from the extra image input during revision.
design_choices.unmeasured_alternative: Template retrieval, image search, planning calls, geometry feedback, multiple repair loops and explicit critics.

design_choices.reason: Text and vision revisions start from exactly the same draft and receive the same change request.
design_choices.unmeasured_alternative: Image tokens, latency and internal reasoning are not matched; this estimates the practical effect of access to screenshots at equal external call count.

design_choices.reason: Exact fresh facts and easy preservation checks without historical benchmark leakage.
design_choices.unmeasured_alternative: Long research sources, investor storytelling, custom graphics and decks exceeding four slides.
